records.claim: continuous glass vault bears on every repeated transverse truss and side arcade
front and rear glazed end walls terminate inside bounded iron arches
low Gothic headhouse bears continuously on grade in front of the shed
clock tower and differentiated pavilions bear through the headhouse frontage
orthographic clock identities are confined to front and side physical clock datums
platforms and rails continue through the complete front-to-rear shed envelope
three raised platforms bear continuously on the station floor and are bounded by stone platform edges
two physical track beds include repeated sleepers and paired rails through the shed
platform canopy roofs bear on repeated cast-iron columns and bounded ridge members
platform benches bear on physical iron legs above the raised platforms
the internal pedestrian bridge bears on two full-height iron supports and has continuous guard rails
